canada.title: Jays tickets, drums and Tinder: Hundreds of purchases made with city credit cards raise questions about misuse
canada.summary: City of Toronto employees used city credit cards to make hundreds of purchases that included Blue Jays tickets, gift cards and later-disputed purchases on Tinder, an analysis of expenditure data by CBC News has found. The city says it has layers of oversight, but experts say it needs to be better.

canada.title: Quebec government's appeal of oath to King ruling to be heard today
canada.summary: Earlier this week, a judge ruled that members of Quebec's provincial legislature must swear allegiance to the Crown before sitting at the National Assembly. He warned that any laws passed could be rendered invalid if members do not take the oath.

canada.title: Ford, Unifor call on Ottawa to exempt Canadian automakers from exhaust pollution penalties

canada.title: Trina Hunt’s family alleges husband killed her, seeks return of assets in B.C. lawsuit

canada.title: Yukon power infrastructure project now at Carney's Major Projects Office
canada.summary: On Thursday evening, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced he would be referring the Whitehorse Power Centres project to the Major Projects Office. The project, which will see a federal investment of up to $73 million, includes two new thermal power plants, a new electrical substation and transmission infrastructure in Whitehorse.
